(#43699)

Context: https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/

This PR was created by running

```
curl "https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/heads/main/net/data/ssl/chrome_root_store/root_store.certs?format=TEXT" | base64 -d > etc/roots.pem
```

Following https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/pull/440 and https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/issues/439 (and other similar decisions across the industry), the `emSign Root CA - G1` is preserved.

Closes #43699
